mapper.select: SELECT id, meeting_id, user_id, sign_method, sign_time, sign_status, location, latitude, longitude, device_info, ip_address, remark, create_time FROM check_in_record WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY sign_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, meeting_id, user_id, sign_method, sign_time, sign_status, location, latitude, longitude, device_info, ip_address, remark, create_time FROM check_in_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sign_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, meeting_id, user_id, sign_method, sign_time, sign_status, location, latitude, longitude, device_info, ip_address, verify_data, remark, create_time FROM check_in_record WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND sign_method = 'photo' ORDER BY sign_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sign_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as signedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sign_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lateCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sign_status IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as attendanceRate FROM check_in_record WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT meeting_id) as totalMeetings, SUM(CASE WHEN sign_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as signedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sign_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lateCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sign_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as absenceCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sign_status IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as attendanceRate FROM check_in_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalSignCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sign_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as signedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sign_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lateCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sign_status IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as attendanceRate FROM check_in_record WHERE sign_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
